sections.title: Your Command Center
sections.vo: Welcome to your dashboard. This is your command center for surplus-funds recovery. At a glance you see your active leads, your pipeline, and what needs attention today. Everything starts here.

sections.title: My Leads
sections.vo: My Leads holds the homeowners assigned only to you. Each one is skip-traced, D-N-C-scrubbed, and never shared with another agent. Click a lead to reveal contact details and start your outreach.

sections.title: State Laws
sections.tagline: Know the rules before you reach out.
sections.vo: Surplus recovery is governed state by state. The State Laws view shows you the claim deadline, the fund holder, and the fee limits that apply, so every claim you pursue is on solid ground.

sections.title: Foreclosure Leads
sections.vo: The Foreclosure Leads board is the heart of the platform. Filter by state, surplus amount, and status. Reveal the owner, send an email draft, a text, or a voice drop, all from one row.

sections.title: Closing Training
sections.vo: Closing Training walks you through the calls that win. Learn how we explain the process, handle objections, and guide an owner to sign the contingency agreement with confidence.

sections.title: Hire a Closer
sections.tagline: Let a pro close it for you.
sections.vo: Not ready to close it yourself? Hire a Closer connects you with an experienced specialist who works your lead and splits the recovery, so deals never stall.

sections.title: Contract Admin
sections.vo: Contract Admin tracks every signed agreement through to the claim filing. Upload the signed page, monitor status, and let us handle the paperwork and the court costs.

sections.title: Automation
sections.vo: Automation puts your follow-up on autopilot. Sequenced emails, texts, and voice drops go out under your name and number, so no lead ever goes cold while you sleep.

sections.title: SMS Messages
sections.vo: SMS Messages keeps every text conversation in one place. Replies route straight to you, so when an owner reaches back out, you are ready to respond.

sections.title: White Label
sections.vo: With White Label you run the whole operation under your own brand. Your name, your landing page, our recovery engine working quietly behind the scenes.

sections.title: State Rules
sections.tagline: The law, verified, in one grid.
sections.vo: State Rules is the legal backbone. Every jurisdiction shows whether a non-attorney may charge a fee, the statutory cap, the deadline, and the citation, reviewed and verified before any document goes out.

sections.title: Compliance Monitor
sections.vo: The Compliance Monitor watches every document before it sends. It checks the state, the amount, the venue, and the disclosures, and flags anything that does not pass, so you stay protected.
